description: Server-to-server conversion submissions to api.impact.com/Advertisers/{AccountSID}/Conversions. The UTT loader is vendor/impact.

params.name: account_sid
params.description: It is the impact.com Account SID in the path as `/Advertisers/{AccountSID}/Conversions`.
params.fix_hint: Put the Account SID from impact.com in the path.

params.name: CampaignId
params.description: It is the program id. impact.com documents `CampaignId` as always required.
params.fix_hint: Set `CampaignId` to the numeric program id.

params.name: ActionTrackerId
params.description: It is the event type id. impact.com documents it as required unless `EventTypeCode` or `EventTypeId` is sent.

params.name: EventTypeId
params.description: It is the event type id. An alternative to `ActionTrackerId`.

params.name: EventTypeCode
params.description: It is the event type code. An alternative to `ActionTrackerId`.

params.name: EventDate
params.description: ISO8601 datetime or the documented NOW fallback. Full calendar validation is performed by the event_date_calendar rule.
params.fix_hint: Send ISO 8601, such as `2026-08-01T23:55:24-08:00`, or `NOW` only when that is all you have.

params.name: OrderId
params.description: It is the unique order id. impact.com uses it for deduplication.

params.name: ClickId
params.description: It is the impact.com click id from `im_ref`. One of the attribution keys impact.com requires.
params.fix_hint: Replay the stored `im_ref` click id as `ClickId`.

params.name: CustomerId
params.description: It is an advertiser-side customer id. impact.com forbids a plaintext email here. One of the attribution keys.

params.name: CustomProfileId
params.description: It identifies a user on the property. One of the attribution keys impact.com requires.

params.name: OrderPromoCode
params.description: It is the promotional code. One of the attribution keys when the code is assigned to a partner.

params.name: UniqueUrl
params.description: It is a unique partner URL. One of the attribution keys impact.com requires.

params.name: GoogAId
params.description: It is the Google advertising id. One of the attribution keys impact.com requires.

params.name: AppleIfa
params.description: It is the Apple IDFA. One of the attribution keys impact.com requires.

params.name: AppleIfv
params.description: It is the Apple IDFV. One of the attribution keys impact.com requires.

params.name: IpAddress
params.description: It is the customer's public IP, used for fraud checks and mobile install attribution. Send it unhashed.

params.name: CurrencyCode
params.description: It is the ISO 4217 currency of the conversion.
params.fix_hint: Use the three-letter code, such as `USD`.

params.name: OrderDiscount
params.description: It is the order-level discount. impact.com documents a decimal amount that is applied proportionately across item subtotals.
params.fix_hint: Send `OrderDiscount` as a number such as `15.00`, without a currency symbol.

params.name: EventCode
params.description: It names the mobile event, such as INSTALL, SIGN-UP, or SALE. impact.com documents it as required when submitting mobile conversions.
params.fix_hint: Send `EventCode` when the conversion is a mobile event.

params.name: AppPackage
params.description: It is the app package name on a mobile conversion.

params.name: IrAppId
params.description: It is the IR App ID on a mobile conversion.

params.name: ItemSku1
params.description: It is a line-item SKU. impact.com documents `ItemSkuN` on the online-sale conversion POST.
params.fix_hint: Send `ItemSku1`, `ItemSku2`, and so on for each SKU set.

params.name: ItemName1
params.description: It is a line-item name. impact.com documents `ItemNameN` on the online-sale conversion POST.

params.name: ItemCategory1
params.description: It is a line-item category. impact.com documents `ItemCategoryN` on the online-sale conversion POST.

params.name: ItemQuantity1
params.description: It is a line-item quantity. impact.com documents `ItemQuantityN` as a positive integer.
params.fix_hint: Send `ItemQuantityN` as a positive integer, such as `2`.

params.name: ItemSubTotal1
params.description: It is a line-item subtotal. impact.com documents `ItemSubTotalN` as the SKU-set total after unit price times quantity.
params.fix_hint: Send `ItemSubTotalN` as a number such as `28.00`, without a currency symbol.

params.name: ItemText1
params.description: It is a general item text field. impact.com documents `ItemText1` through `ItemText10` as optional strings of at most 64 characters.
params.fix_hint: Send `ItemTextN` as a string of at most 64 characters, or drop the pair.

params.name: ItemNumeric1
params.description: Published DECIMAL(18,3) reporting value. Extra precision may need rounding; no server rejection behavior is claimed.
params.fix_hint: Send `ItemNumericN` as a number such as `10.00`, without a currency symbol.

params.name: ItemDate1
params.description: It is a general item date field. impact.com documents `ItemDate1` through `ItemDate10` with ISO-like dates, with or without a time.
params.fix_hint: Send `ItemDateN` as a documented date such as `2026-08-06` or `2026-08-06T13:14:57-07:00`.

params.name: ItemMoney1
params.description: Published DECIMAL(18,3) reporting value. Extra precision may need rounding; no server rejection behavior is claimed.
params.fix_hint: Send `ItemMoneyN` as a number such as `12.50`, without a currency symbol.

rules.message: The conversion has no event type. impact.com documents `ActionTrackerId`, `EventTypeId`, or `EventTypeCode` as required.
rules.fix_hint: Send `EventTypeId` or `ActionTrackerId` from Settings, Event Types.

rules.message: The conversion has no attribution key. impact.com documents at least one of `ClickId`, `CustomerId`, `CustomProfileId`, a promo code, `UniqueUrl`, `GoogAId`, `AppleIfa`, or `AppleIfv`.
rules.fix_hint: Replay the stored `im_ref` as `ClickId`, or send another documented attribution key.

rules.message: `CustomerId` carries what looks like a raw email address. impact.com documents customer ids as non-identifying.
rules.fix_hint: Send a non-identifying customer id, not a plaintext email.

rules.message: `IpAddress` looks like a SHA-256 digest, but impact.com documents it as the customer's public IP, unhashed.
A mobile conversion has `AppPackage` and no `EventCode`. impact.com documents `EventCode` as required when submitting mobile conversions.
EventDate must be a calendar-valid ISO8601 datetime, or the documented NOW fallback.
A submitted call conversion must contain every required call tracking field.
Passing SubIds or SharedId on a normal conversion requires ClickId. Call fields have a separately documented optional ClickId branch.
The optional Note field requires MediaPartnerId. MediaId is its documented alias.
